_comment: Merge these into your project's composer.json, then copy db-codegen.policy.php, phinx.php and scripts/ into the project (plus your db/migrations). Point `out`/`namespace` in db-codegen.policy.php at your paths, keep phinx.php pointed at your migrations dir, and run `composer generate-db`. Wire it into CI by running `composer generate-db` AND your static analyser (PHPStan/Psalm) over the generated namespace before build/test, so nothing ever runs against a stale or unverified schema. Generation needs Docker running (Docker Desktop, colima, ...) for testcontainers, plus the pdo_pgsql extension.
